Reduces administrative overhead and ensures timely revocation of access for offboarded users.", "detailed_specification": ["Administrators shall be able to create new user accounts with required fields (e.g., user identifier, email, role).", "The system shall enforce uniqueness of user identifiers.", "Administrators can update user profile details and reset passwords.", "Account deactivation shall immediately revoke access; deletion shall permanently remove account data after a review period.", "All changes to accounts must be logged in the audit trail."], "success_criteria_kpis": ["Eliminate manual user provisioning delays through systematic account management."], "dependencies_constraints": ["Requires authentication and role management modules to be operational.", "Account deletion must consider referential integrity with related business data."], "sources": [{"source_id": "99a48aa4-6261-41f5-ab2c-62a33584e289", "pages": [{"page": 1, "bboxes": [{"fragment_id": "8e22e0b3-446a-4fa2-9a7c-52f2b19763db", "bbox": {"x": 77.28, "y": 255.0, "w": 420.3, "h": 22.4}}, {"fragment_id": "c1ce89a1-5096-434e-8a4d-5ad381d22eb1", "bbox": {"x": 77.39, "y": 315.45, "w": 312.97, "h": 10.85}}]}]}]}]}, {"mod_code": "2", "name": "Data Management", "requirements": [{"id": "BR-DATA-01", "title": "Comprehensive CRUD Operations", "mapped_features": ["2.1"], "category": "Functional", "description": "The system must provide create, read, update, and delete operations for all core business data entities, with validation and user feedback.", "rationale": "Empower users to maintain accurate and current business records within the system. Provides accountability and aids in detecting and investigating suspicious activities.", "detailed_specification": ["The system shall automatically log events such as user logins, data modifications, configuration changes, and report generations.", "Each log entry must include a timestamp, user identifier, action type, affected record, and details of the change.", "Audit logs must be searchable and filterable by date range, user, action type, etc.", "Logs must be retained for a defined retention period and be exportable for external review.", "Log data must be protected from unauthorized access and modification."], "success_criteria_kpis": ["Enable comprehensive forensic review of any business-critical transaction."], "dependencies_constraints": ["Logging must not significantly degrade system performance.", "Requires adequate storage capacity for log retention."], "sources": [{"source_id": "99a48aa4-6261-41f5-ab2c-62a33584e289", "pages": [{"page": 1, "bboxes": [{"fragment_id": "8e22e0b3-446a-4fa2-9a7c-52f2b19763db", "bbox": {"x": 77.28, "y": 255.0, "w": 420.3, "h": 22.4}}, {"fragment_id": "052242bb-ae99-47e0-b854-922adac09fa9", "bbox": {"x": 77.57, "y": 411.0, "w": 320.07, "h": 10.84}}]}]}]}]}, {"mod_code": "5", "name": "System Configuration", "requirements": [{"id": "BR-CONF-01", "title": "System Configuration Management", "mapped_features": ["5.1"], "category": "Functional", "description": "The system must provide administrators with the ability to configure system-wide settings, role permissions, and operational parameters through a user interface, without requiring code changes.", "rationale": "Allow business administrators to adapt the system to evolving needs without developer intervention, improving agility. Reduces maintenance costs and downtime associated with configuration changes.", "detailed_specification": ["Administrators shall be able to modify global settings such as default page sizes, date formats, and notification preferences.", "The configuration interface must allow assignment and modification of role-based permissions for all features.", "Configuration changes must be logged in the audit trail.", "The system shall validate configuration inputs to prevent invalid settings."], "success_criteria_kpis": ["Eliminate the need for development releases for routine configuration adjustments."], "dependencies_constraints": ["Only users with Administrator role shall access configuration interface.", "Certain configuration changes may require system restart or cache refresh — system must handle gracefully."], "sources": [{"source_id": "99a48aa4-6261-41f5-ab2c-62a33584e289", "pages": [{"page": 1, "bboxes": [{"fragment_id": "8e22e0b3-446a-4fa2-9a7c-52f2b19763db", "bbox": {"x": 77.28, "y": 255.0, "w": 420.3, "h": 22.4}}, {"fragment_id": "c1ce89a1-5096-434e-8a4d-5ad381d22eb1", "bbox": {"x": 77.39, "y": 315.45, "w": 312.97, "h": 10.85}}]}]}]}]}, {"mod_code": "6", "name": "User Interface & Accessibility", "requirements": [{"id": "BR-UI-01", "title": "Responsive User Interface", "mapped_features": ["6.1", "6.2", "6.3"], "category": "Functional", "description": "The application must present a responsive user interface that adapts to various screen sizes, with clear navigation and pagination for data-intensive screens.", "rationale": "Provide a consistent and usable experience across desktop and mobile devices, improving user satisfaction and productivity. Increases user adoption and reduces training time by offering an intuitive interface.", "detailed_specification": ["All forms and data views must resize and reflow to fit the browser window width without horizontal scrolling, where possible.", "Navigation menus must be accessible from all pages and indicate the user's current location.", "Long lists of records must be divided into pages with controls to navigate and select page size.", "The interface must provide visual feedback for actions such as loading, saving, and errors."], "success_criteria_kpis": ["Enable staff to complete common tasks without interface-induced errors or confusion."], "dependencies_constraints": ["Modern web browser support is required; legacy browser compatibility may be limited.", "UI performance must remain smooth under typical data loads."], "sources": [{"source_id": "99a48aa4-6261-41f5-ab2c-62a33584e289", "pages": [{"page": 1, "bboxes": [{"fragment_id": "ce65e52a-de9a-45b3-bd3d-e89abc01bf3d", "bbox": {"x": 77.68, "y": 363.03, "w": 326.13, "h": 10.61}}]}]}]}, {"id": "BR-UI-02", "title": "Accessibility Compliance", "mapped_features": ["6.4"], "category": "Compliance", "description": "The application must adhere to recognized accessibility standards to ensure it is usable by people with disabilities, including compatibility with assistive technologies.", "rationale": "Ensure equal access to the system for all users, meeting regulatory and ethical obligations. Broadens user base and mitigates legal risks associated with accessibility non-compliance.", "detailed_specification": ["The interface must provide sufficient color contrast and allow for text resizing without loss of functionality.", "All interactive elements must be navigable using keyboard alone.", "Forms must include appropriate labels and instructions that are programmatically determinable.", "The system must be compatible with common assistive technologies."], "success_criteria_kpis": ["Enable users with disabilities to navigate and use core system features without assistance."], "dependencies_constraints": ["Compliance must be considered at all levels of UI design; may require training for developers.", "Third-party components must also meet accessibility criteria."], "sources": [{"source_id": "99a48aa4-6261-41f5-ab2c-62a33584e289", "pages": [{"page": 1, "bboxes": [{"fragment_id": "ce65e52a-de9a-45b3-bd3d-e89abc01bf3d", "bbox": {"x": 77.68, "y": 363.03, "w": 326.13, "h": 10.61}}]}]}]}]}, {"mod_code": "7", "name": "Non-Functional Requirements", "requirements": [{"id": "BR-NFR-01", "title": "System Performance", "mapped_features": ["1.1", "1.2", "2.1", "2.2", "2.3", "3.1", "3.2", "4.1", "5.1", "6.1", "6.2", "6.3", "6.4"], "category": "Functional", "description": "The system must meet performance targets to ensure a responsive user experience under typical and peak load conditions.", "rationale": "Slow system response leads to user frustration and decreased productivity. Maintaining acceptable performance is critical to user adoption and business process efficiency.", "detailed_specification": ["Page loads and form submissions must complete within acceptable time limits under normal operation.", "Search and report generation must be optimized to handle large data volumes without significant delays.", "The system should be designed to scale horizontally to accommodate growing data and user concurrency.", "Performance testing must be part of the quality assurance process to identify bottlenecks."], "success_criteria_kpis": ["Enable users to complete data entry and retrieval tasks without experiencing system lag that impedes workflow."], "dependencies_constraints": ["Performance optimization must not compromise data integrity or security.", "Hardware and network resources must be provisioned according to estimated load."], "sources": [{"source_id": "99a48aa4-6261-41f5-ab2c-62a33584e289", "pages": [{"page": 1, "bboxes": [{"fragment_id": "052242bb-ae99-47e0-b854-922adac09fa9", "bbox": {"x": 77.57, "y": 411.0, "w": 320.07, "h": 10.84}}]}]}]}, {"id": "BR-NFR-02", "title": "System Availability", "mapped_features": ["1.1", "1.2", "2.1", "2.2", "2.3", "3.1", "3.2", "4.1", "5.1", "6.1", "6.2", "6.3", "6.4"], "category": "Functional", "description": "The system must maintain high availability during business hours, with minimal planned downtime for maintenance.", "rationale": "Downtime directly impacts business operations and revenue; the system must be consistently accessible. Ensures continuous business operations and user trust.", "detailed_specification": ["The system shall implement redundancy and failover mechanisms to recover from hardware failures without data loss.", "Scheduled maintenance should be performed during low-usage periods and communicated in advance.", "The system must gracefully handle transient errors and provide meaningful messages to users when unavailable.", "Availability monitoring tools should be in place to alert administrators of outages."], "success_criteria_kpis": ["Reduce unexpected downtime to a minimum, maintaining continuous operations during business-critical hours."], "dependencies_constraints": ["Requires reliable hosting infrastructure and network connectivity.", "Disaster recovery plans must be in place and tested."], "sources": [{"source_id": "99a48aa4-6261-41f5-ab2c-62a33584e289", "pages": [{"page": 1, "bboxes": [{"fragment_id": "052242bb-ae99-47e0-b854-922adac09fa9", "bbox": {"x": 77.57, "y": 411.0, "w": 320.07, "h": 10.84}}]}]}]}, {"id": "BR-NFR-03", "title": "Security and Data Protection", "mapped_features": ["1.1", "1.2", "2.1", "2.2", "2.3", "3.1", "3.2", "4.1", "5.1", "6.1", "6.2", "6.3", "6.4"], "category": "Compliance", "description": "The system must implement industry-standard security measures to protect data at rest, in transit, and during processing, covering confidentiality, integrity, and availability.", "rationale": "Protect sensitive business and user data from breaches, unauthorized access, and tampering. Maintains stakeholder trust and meets legal and regulatory obligations.", "detailed_specification": ["All data transmission between client and server must be encrypted using industry-standard encryption protocols.", "Sensitive data stored in databases must be encrypted using accepted algorithms.", "The system must defend against common web vulnerabilities (e.g., injection attacks, cross-site scripting).", "Regular security assessments and penetration testing must be conducted.", "Access controls must follow the principle of least privilege."], "success_criteria_kpis": ["Prevent successful unauthorized access attempts and data breaches as verified by security testing."], "dependencies_constraints": ["Security patches must be applied promptly.", "User authentication and audit logging are foundational for security."], "sources": [{"source_id": "99a48aa4-6261-41f5-ab2c-62a33584e289", "pages": [{"page": 1, "bboxes": [{"fragment_id": "052242bb-ae99-47e0-b854-922adac09fa9", "bbox": {"x": 77.57, "y": 411.0, "w": 320.07, "h": 10.84}}, {"fragment_id": "92440115-8c83-4ee2-9e93-e7469459de03", "bbox": {"x": 77.77, "y": 207.41, "w": 291.32, "h": 10.43}}]}]}]}, {"id": "BR-NFR-04", "title": "Maintainability and Scalability", "mapped_features": ["1.1", "1.2", "2.1", "2.2", "2.3", "3.1", "3.2", "4.1", "5.1", "6.1", "6.2", "6.3", "6.4"], "category": "Functional", "description": "The system architecture must support ongoing maintenance, easy updates, and the ability to scale to accommodate growth in users, data, and functionality.", "rationale": "A maintainable system reduces long-term operational costs and allows for rapid adaptation to business changes. Protects investment by ensuring the system can evolve without prohibitive rework.", "detailed_specification": ["The system shall be built using a modular architecture that allows independent development and deployment of components.", "Code must follow consistent standards and be accompanied by documentation.", "Automated tests should be included to validate changes.", "The system should use development practices that support maintainability."], "success_criteria_kpis": ["Reduce the time and effort required to implement and deploy new features over the system lifecycle."], "dependencies_constraints": ["Requires adherence to coding standards and documentation practices.", "Scalability may depend on infrastructure choices."], "sources": [{"source_id": "99a48aa4-6261-41f5-ab2c-62a33584e289", "pages": [{"page": 1, "bboxes": [{"fragment_id": "92440115-8c83-4ee2-9e93-e7469459de03", "bbox": {"x": 77.77, "y": 207.41, "w": 291.32, "h": 10.43}}, {"fragment_id": "052242bb-ae99-47e0-b854-922adac09fa9", "bbox": {"x": 77.57, "y": 411.0, "w": 320.07, "h": 10.84}}]}]}]}, {"id": "BR-NFR-05", "title": "Data Backup and Recovery", "mapped_features": ["1.1", "1.2", "2.1", "2.2", "2.3", "3.1", "3.2", "4.1", "5.1", "6.1", "6.2", "6.3", "6.4"], "category": "Functional", "description": "The system must include mechanisms for regular backups of all critical data and provide the ability to restore data to a consistent state in the event of data loss or corruption.", "rationale": "Ensure business continuity and data integrity by protecting against accidental deletion, hardware failure, or disasters. Minimizes risk of data loss and associated business impact.", "detailed_specification": ["Regular backups of the database and configuration files must be performed and verified.", "The backup process must be automated and include logging of success/failure.", "The system must allow authorized personnel to restore data from a backup point with minimal downtime.", "Backups must be stored securely, both on-site and off-site, to prevent loss from localized incidents."], "success_criteria_kpis": ["Enable full data recovery from a backup within a timeframe that meets business continuity objectives."], "dependencies_constraints": ["Backup frequency and retention policies must be defined based on business criticality.", "Restoration testing should be conducted periodically."], "sources": [{"source_id": "99a48aa4-6261-41f5-ab2c-62a33584e289", "pages": [{"page": 1, "bboxes": [{"fragment_id": "052242bb-ae99-47e0-b854-922adac09fa9", "bbox": {"x": 77.57, "y": 411.0, "w": 320.07, "h": 10.84}}]}]}]}]}], "exclusions": ["Testing Scope activities (Functional, UI, API, regression, security, performance, UAT) are outside the scope of the application features; they are quality assurance processes applied to the system.", "Acceptance Criteria definition and validation are project governance activities and not implemented as system functionality.", "The Executive Summary and Objectives sections describe the rationale and goals but do not constitute functional requirements."]}
